summary: Genre/style selections inject only their canonical genre term by default.
rules: Genre JSON defines identity and grouping only.
Genre prompt arrays contain one canonical prompt term only.
Genre excludes are empty to avoid hidden genre-specific negative prompt pollution.
Tempo is user-driven and is not owned by genre nodes.
Vocal delivery belongs in vocals.json, not genres.json.
Instrumentation, production, mood, lyrical details, and weird specifics are user-selected or handled by their own JSONs.
